message:
In the concealed twin Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) support concept, the U-bolt preload and slip verification has incomplete closure. To check it I used process review of the slip factor calculation (E15) against the unit weight calculation (E10). I found 14.68 dimensionless slip margin for 2452.5 newtons per unit, according to Coulomb, 1785. I propose Retrofit Integration Architect please link preload calculation to resolve the slip objection (O2). My position: not ready because support safety evidence is unlinked.

In the twin under-deck TMD retrofit concept, the tuning basis has 1.81 hertz versus 1.86 hertz inconsistency. To check it I used whiteboard cross-check of the Den Hartog optimum result (E3). I found 1.81 hertz at 5.0 percent mass ratio differing by 0.05 hertz from inspiration, according to Den Hartog, 1934. I propose Structural Dynamics Lead please reconcile mass ratio with Vibration Control Specialist before ready stands. My position: not ready because tuning basis is disputed.

In the crowd comfort verification concept, the acceptance method has target drift from Comfort Level (CL, Setra comfort grade) CL1 to CL2. To check it I used comparison of the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (E6) with inherent damping baseline. I found 0.74 metres per second squared exceeding 0.5 metres per second squared, according to Setra, 2006. I propose Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner please confirm explicit CL2 acceptance. My position: not ready because vote came too early.
Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: slip linkage requested.
Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: tuning reconciliation requested.
Note on Vibration Control Specialist: tuning confirmation requested.
Note on Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner: CL target confirmation requested.
